query.source: BDB 2025, 2022 weeks 1–9 play/player metadata; input SHA-256 and sizes match data/reviews/run-game-coordination/nfl-reference.json.
query.declarationScope: Frozen before executing this NEW collector, after an initial descriptive audit of these metadata and existing summaries. This is not an outcome-blind preregistration.
query.selection: playNullifiedByPenalty=N, isDropback=FALSE, no kneel/spike, observed rushLocationType and finite yardsGained. Provider-defined designed runs; all runner positions retained, including QB runs and tricks.
query.sneaks: qbSneak=true OR pff_runConceptPrimary=SNEAK is a separate QB_SNEAK class. Raw primary labels remain unchanged; ordinaryRuns excludes this class. Any flag/label disagreement is reported.
query.yards: Main outcomes use finite yardsGained, matching the existing run-tracking/tendency references. prePenaltyYardsGained is a separate operator with its own known denominator; differences and missingness are reported. Neither is silently substituted for the other.
query.penalties: Keep non-nullified rows with recorded penaltyYards. Missing, zero and nonzero values are distinguished; field presence is not a complete penalty-event label. No assertion that non-nullified means penalty-free.
query.outcomes: Positive>0, zero=0, negative<0, stuff<=0, explosive>=10 and >=20 yards. Every rate reports numerator and known denominator. Gain-threshold success requires >=40% of yardsToGo on first down, >=60% on second and >=100% on third/fourth; this convention is not EPA success. Conversion requires gain>=positive yardsToGo.
query.fieldGeometry: Yards to the opponent end zone derived from possessionTeam, yardlineSide and yardlineNumber; the 50 is midfield. Invalid/unknown side or distance stays unknown.
query.labels: Preserve exact pff_runConceptPrimary and raw pff_runConceptSecondary. MAN is not verified Duo; OUTSIDE ZONE does not isolate wide zone/toss. Secondary SPLIT/READ OPTION/LEAD/PITCH are provider modifiers, not verified simulator concept classes. Token margins overlap; raw single/compound values are also separate.
query.support: Retain every cell including thin cells. Expose cell counts in 1–4,5–19,20–99,100+ bins; all rates retain their actual denominator. Team and team/primary margins describe the observed nine-week snapshot, not confidence intervals or independent league-strength effects.
query.rusher: Exact game/play join to hadRushAttempt in player_play.csv and nflId to players.csv. No rusher, multiple rushers or missing roster position stays explicit, and does not exclude an otherwise eligible metadata play.
query.box: If n_defenders_in_box or defendersInBox exists, retain that numeric count and its denominator as a presentation label, never a defensive front or rush count. No value is invented when absent.
query.inference: Descriptive metadata outcomes only. No tracking/contact/footwork measurements, no causation, no confidence intervals, no direct engine accuracy claim. Concept/situation/team/personnel selection differs from controlled lab calls and the old personnel-filtered tendency cohort.
